newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-Courtaulds says most costs in 1996.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Courtaulds says most costs in 1996.

text.p: Courtaulds Textiles Plc said on Tuesday that most of the 30 to 35 million stg it plans to spend on restructuring will fall in the second half of 1996.

In a telephone interview with Reuters the group's new chief executive Colin Dyer said his aim is to move ahead quickly on reorganisation, which includes further disposals and the creation of four product-led divisions, and get back to a "clean set of results."
Dyer also said the company is to shed jobs in Britain and western Europe and increase production in low wage economies, especially in Asia.
